description: Central Province - Notifying that the Proposal of Imposing Entertainment Tax adopted by the Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha was approved by the Minister in Charge
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the imposition of an entertainment tax by a Provincial Council under the authority of the Entertainment Tax Ordinance. It involves the creation of a new tax regulation and specifies the tax rates and implementation details, which falls under legal/regulatory matters concerning taxation frameworks and compliance requirements.
